title: Gluing O-linear maps on one covering family
statement: Let C be a site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], O a sheaf of commutative rings, and F,G sheaves of O-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Given an object U and a covering family {U_i\to U}, every family of O|_{U_i}-linear morphisms φ_i:F|_{U_i}\to G|_{U_i} that agrees after restriction to U_i\times_U U_j glues to a unique O|_U-linear morphism φ:F|_U\to G|_U.
